ITEM 1 | White cauliflower-like florets, matte creamy-white surface with slightly bumpy, granular texture, clustered in a loose group of about 10-12 small heads roughly 2-3 cm across, dry with no sheen, sitting on the left side of the red plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Whole red-and-green apple, glossy smooth skin with red blush over yellow-green background, about 7-8 cm diameter, sitting centrally on top of the other foods | 180
ITEM 3 | Small whole cherry tomatoes, glossy red-orange skin, about 2-3 cm each, five or six pieces scattered around the upper right of the apple | 60
ITEM 4 | Carrot pieces, bright orange with slightly matte surface, cut into rounds and diagonal coins about 0.5-1 cm thick and 3-5 cm long, some halved lengthwise, arranged across the lower and right side of the plate | 150
